notes.title: ID Cards Patch
notes.notes:
This small patch should fix the ID cards achievement. 

If you've already collected the ID cards, there's a small chance the achievement could properly fire off when starting the game. 

If not, you would have to re-do this achievement from a new game.

We apologize for the issue!

notes.title: Achievements have arrived!
notes.notes:
We heard your feedback loud and clear, and we are happy to announce that we've finally updated the game to include achievements.

There are 39 in the game!

The achievements are as follows:

[b]Memory Finder[/b]
Found a memory of the Shadow Haven facility in Kane's mind.

[b]ID Master[/b]
Collected all 10 ID cards!

[b]Mindspace Agent[/b]
Entered into Kane's mindspace.

[b]Fate's Connection[/b]
Met and spoke with Evelynn.

[b]Over-The-Shoulder Master[/b]
Completed game in Over-The-Shoulder mode

[b]Fixed Camera Master[/b]
Completed the game in fixed-camera mode.

[b]Memory Passage User[/b]
Used a memory passage to save and upload a snapshot.

[b]Warden Defeater[/b]
Defeated the prison warden boss!

[b]Sentry Immobilizer[/b]
Immobilized The Sentry in the Shadow Haven memory using an M9!

[b]Master Sentry Immobilizer[/b]
Immobilized The Sentry in front of the church!

[b]Home Invader[/b]
Found a memory of Kane's house and entered inside.

[b]Kane Interrogator[/b]
Spoke to Kane in a memory of his Shadow Haven work office.

[b]Altruist[/b]
Chose to stay in Kane's Mindspace.

[b]Deserter[/b]
Chose to leave Kane's Mindspace.

[b]M9 Disrupter[/b]
Disrupted the electrical power by shooting it with an M9!

[b]Bonus Looter[/b]
Found a way to unlock bonus loot in the church.

[b]Deagle Acquired[/b]
Acquired pastor Dave's Desert Eagle.

[b]Electric Grenade Launcher[/b]
Found and assembled an electric grenade launcher!

[b]Red Gem[/b]
Acquired red gem.

[b]Gem Finder[/b]
Acquired a silver gem.

[b]Yellow Gem[/b]
Acquired yellow gem.

[b]Green Gem[/b]
Acquired green gem.

[b]Blue Gem[/b]
Acquired blue gem.

[b]Glitcher Defeater[/b]
Defeated a glitching scraper!

[b]Scraper Defeater[/b]
Defeated a scraper.

[b]Perfectionist[/b]
Landed a skill check in the perfect zone!

[b]Headshotter[/b]
Defeated an enemy with a headshot!

[b]Serum Mixer[/b]
Mixed blue and yellow serums to create a green serum.

[b]Machete Butcher[/b]
Defeated an enemy with a machete.

[b]Combiner[/b]
Combined two items together.

[b]MP5[/b]
Acquired an MP5.

[b]Extender[/b]
Extended inventory space by acquiring pouch bag.

[b]Curious Explorer[/b]
Your curiosity has rewarded you with an extra pouch bag.

[b]Bolt Cutter Breaker[/b]
Broke bolt cutters by disrupting the electrical panel's power.

[b]Destroyer of Brain Matter[/b]
Successfully blew up a large piece of brain matter.

[b]Spider Defeater[/b]
Defeated a spider scraper.

[b]Quick Reactor![/b]
Dodged a scraper attack by rolling.

[b]The 100[/b]
Defeated 100 enemies!

[b]Headshot Master[/b]
Defeated 30 enemies with a headshot.


Note: this patch also includes very minor bug / text issue fixes.

notes.title: Arabic Language + Controller Bug fixed
notes.notes:
- Arabic translations were broken, and should now be fixed in this latest update.
- An input bug when playing with a controller and operating the radio's in Kane's home has been fixed.

notes.title: Tiny Patch!
notes.notes:
- A few misc bugs were patched that could break certain spots of the game for a few minutes.
- Korean translation fixed in The Haven Poem
- Some players were missing key elements of a certain puzzle, which has now been clarified.

notes.title: Fixed: Controller Input Bug
notes.notes: The issue regarding controller moving by itself should be resolved in this latest patch.

notes.title: Misc Bugs & Changes Addressed
notes.notes:
- Added extra clues in the easy puzzle mode
- Fixed a few confusing notes
- Few levels have had small design updates.
- Graphics setting bug fixed
- Settings window bug fixed

notes.title: Introducing: Puzzle Difficulty Modes
notes.notes:
We've created an option to start your game with different puzzle difficulties.

[b]Easy Mode:[/b] More explicit clues in the game on how to solve some of the more difficult puzzles.

[b]Standard Mode:[/b] Harder to solve puzzles. Subtle clues. (This was the default mode before this update).

We look forward to doing achievements next.

notes.title: Requested New Features & Fixes
notes.notes:
We have some updates for everyone!

- You can now invert X and Y axis in the camera settings window
- Difficulty settings added (Easy, Standard, Nightmare). 
[list]
Easy: Lowers damage taken from enemies, increases power of all weapons
Nightmare: Increases damage taken from enemies, decreases weapon power.
[/list]
- Cleared up a few confusing areas.
- Buffed MP5 and Desert Eagle.
- Nerfed extremely fast quick-time event on glitch scraper.
- Added missing map to future prison.
- Increased notice icon visibility on a few items.
- Demo saves will no longer show up in the full game when purchased (And full game saves will not show up in a demo version either)
- Localized text on maps directly.

For our next update, we will work on achievements.


Thank you all!
- Devs

notes.title: Small Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
- Combination bug in the inventory has been fixed.
- Skipping cutscene buttons improved (To avoid accidental skips!)

Our next update will include some of your feature requests.

notes.title: Launching October 25, 2024
notes.notes:
[h1]"Connection: The Nightmare Within" – Launching October 25, 2024[/h1]

We are thrilled to announce that Connection: The Nightmare Within will officially release on [b]October 25, 2024[/b]! Prepare to dive into a chilling, immersive experience like no other. This game has been a labor of love, and we can't wait to share it with you.

A massive thank you goes out to everyone who participated in our playtests and provided invaluable feedback. Your support has helped shape Connection into something truly special.

Get ready to confront your deepest fears! 

The nightmare is almost here :)

notes.title: Your feedback was intense!
notes.notes:
We have a new demo version out which addresses the tons of feedback everyone has given.

- Improved cutscene animations
- Combat updates which include more hit reactions to enemies, better death animations, quicker aim controls for the player, and other polishes
- Updates to various environments.
- Improved camera work for certain actions.
- Bug fixes in various areas.
- Technical issues such as widescreen support are improved
- Human translation to various languages (more to come in the future as well)

We now shift focus to finishing the final parts as quickly as possible. Stay tuned and keep giving us feedback!

notes.title: Bug Fixes, Improved Story
notes.notes:
There was a bug that caused the pistol to not render. That has been fixed.

The intro story has a new cutscene for players to watch, as we have fleshed out the story even further.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Major Cutscene Updates
notes.notes:
Time for a big update from our game development journey! We've been working super hard, and we've hit a major milestone: our cutscenes are now looking more awesome than ever before!

You know those cool moments in games where the story gets all cinematic, like you're watching a movie? Well, we wanted our game to have tons of those moments, so we've been tweaking and tuning our cutscenes to make them really stand out.

We've played around with colors and lighting to make everything pop and feel more like you're watching a blockbuster movie. Whether it's a sunny day or a spooky night, the scenes are now bursting with cinematic vibes.

We've also been busy improving the way our characters move and act in these scenes. We've added smoother animations to help movement feel more natural and lifelike.

What's Next?

We're not done yet (but we are very close to finishing the game)! Keep an eye out for more updates and sneak peeks as we get closer to finishing the game. We can't wait to share more of our journey with you!

Thanks for being part of our game development adventure!

notes.title: The Final Stage!
notes.notes:
Warning: SMALL SPOILER ahead! 

We want to share a video of a new level we've worked hard on. 

Can you find your way through the maze and survive what awaits?

This is a new level (one of the final levels) with new puzzles, near the end of the game.

Playing this area in Fixed-Camera mode is especially fun, as the game goes into a sort of top-down action arcade follow camera.

Not only is this new maze in the game, there are some challenging puzzles in the final stage we completed, extra cutscenes we've worked on, and an extra cool weapon you will absolutely love shooting.

And more of course.

We hope you enjoy the update, as we are getting much closer to completion :)

notes.title: The Weapons!
notes.notes:
With our new demo release right around the corner, we're thrilled to announce a major update that is set to elevate your gaming experience to new heights! 🎮✨ Get ready for a whole new level of intensity as we introduce three brand-new weapons that will change the way you navigate the battlefield.

1️⃣ Power-Packed Shotgun with Blowback:
Are you ready to feel the force? Say hello to our latest addition - a shotgun with a powerful blowback effect. Get up close and personal with your foes as you unleash devastating blows that will leave them scrambling. 

2️⃣ Explosive Grenade Launcher for AOE Damage:
Brace yourselves for explosive mayhem! Introducing the game-changing grenade launcher, designed to deliver unparalleled area-of-effect (AOE) damage. Clear out enemy clusters and see them actually blow to pieces.

3️⃣ Rapid-Fire SMG (Submachine Gun):
A secretly placed SMG is here to provide you with rapid and accurate firepower.

notes.title: Major Milestone Update!
notes.notes:
We're elated to share the thrilling news about our latest game update, a result of countless late nights and unwavering dedication from our passionate team. Get ready to embark on an enhanced gaming journey with a plethora of new features, improvements, and surprises that we've meticulously crafted just for you.

Here's a closer look at what's in store:

[b]1. Revitalized Levels:[/b]
Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world as we've re-lit and re-colored every level, ensuring a captivating and vibrant gaming experience.

[b]2. Diverse Enemies, Unique Abilities:[/b]
Encounter new challenges with the introduction of multiple enemy types, each wielding unique abilities that demand strategic thinking and adaptability.

[b]3. Expanded Arsenal:[/b]
Arm yourself with a diverse array of new guns, each designed to bring a fresh dynamic to your gameplay.

[b]4. Extended Playable Areas:[/b]
Embark on an even more extensive adventure! We've added numerous playable areas, effectively doubling the length of the game for a richer gaming experience.

[b]5. Deeper Lore and Storyline:[/b]
Unravel the mysteries of our game with a significantly expanded narrative. We've invested time in explaining the story more thoroughly, ensuring a more immersive and engaging experience.

[b]6. More Cinematics, More Drama:[/b]
Brace yourself for jaw-dropping cut scenes that add cinematic flair and depth to the unfolding story.

[b]7. Crystalline Sound Quality:[/b]
Your in-game world just got an auditory upgrade! We've revamped sound quality to elevate the impact of every shot and explosion.

[b]8. Formidable Boss Battles:[/b]
Confront two new bosses with unique mechanics, providing a challenging yet thrilling test of your gaming skills.

[b]9. Dialogue-Rich Areas:[/b]
Engage with characters on a deeper level as we've expanded dialogue-rich areas, allowing you to become even more immersed in the game's narrative.

[b]10. Sleek UI and Main Menu:[/b]
Experience a smoother and more intuitive journey with a revamped user interface and main menu.

[b]11. Enchanting Musical Scores:[/b]
Let the game come alive with a suite of new music tracks, specially composed to enhance your gaming atmosphere.

[b]12. Visual Marvels:[/b]
Enjoy improved textures, visuals, and environments teeming with intricate details and nuance.

[b]13. Bug Squashing Bonanza:[/b]
We've combed through every nook and cranny, addressing bugs to ensure a seamless and enjoyable gaming experience.

[b]14. Worldwide Reach:[/b]
For our global player base, we've introduced localization for different languages, breaking down barriers and making our game accessible to an even wider audience.

ːsteamthumbsupː

We're particularly proud of the progress we've made in explaining the game's story in greater detail, providing players with a deeper understanding of the immersive world they inhabit.

Your support and feedback have been our guiding lights throughout this journey. As we continue to evolve, we're committed to delivering an unparalleled gaming experience.

Thank you for being part of our community!

Stay tuned for more thrilling updates!

Best regards,
The Devs!
